limitations.note: The rewrite alternates between two states instead of fixing the counter to reach state 2 and emit a second packed word on the third valid byte.
The rewrite also changes the first output word to use the second byte’s low nibble, whereas the original and reference both use its high nibble.
The test encoded the rewrite’s assumptions by expecting the low nibble on the second valid byte and no output on the third, so it passed while rejecting the reference behavior.
